sources.title: Ansökningsstatistik (Arcada)
sources.covers: Antagningsstatistik 2022-2026: only first-preference applicants, all applicants and accepted-place counts per programme; no points

notes: Arcada publishes no lowest-accepted-points (lägsta antagna poäng) for betygsbaserad antagning. Its statistics page for 2022-2026 gives applicant and accepted counts only and refers to vipunen.fi for more. Programme admission pages (e.g. Socionom dagstudier) and the FAQ only describe the scoring rules. https://www.arcada.fi/sv/hur-kan-jag-bli-antagen returned HTTP 403 and could not be checked. Searches in Swedish and English found nothing else on arcada.fi.
